title: how I name my files
caption:
I use git for code. for everything else, there's this.

report. report_v2. report_final. report_final_FINAL.
report_final_FINAL_use-this. report_old_DONT_DELETE.
and the one that's actually right: report (1).docx.

what's the worst file name on your computer right now?

slide.kicker: the right one is (1). it's always (1).
